ns2:section.sectionText: This gateway course is designed to help first-year students learn the skills to succeed in their university careers and develop relationships within the College of Liberal Arts and Sciences (LAS). Students will become familiar with the resources on campus as well as within LAS. During weekly class sessions, students will participate in discussions and activities that help them integrate into the LAS and university community at large. They will explore many opportunities available to them and learn strategies for addressing common challenges facing first-year students, such as developing effective priority management and study skills, thinking critically and avoiding the common pitfalls that can undermine success at the University of Illinois.
